Hi Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest yet. The scheduler refused the request because the Gateway isn't authorized to manage scheduled jobs (it reports missing gateway auth credentials). I haven't created anything, and nothing has been posted.

Once the scheduler works, I'll set it up as you described:

- **When:** every Monday at 08:00, starting Monday 19 October. I'm assuming Chicago time, since that's the time zone your message used. Tell me if you meant UTC.
- **Where:** posted here in #coastal-team.
- **What:** a "Coastal week ahead" digest covering the previous week in #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus open customer items.
- **Finance:** the digest will leave out money terms (rates, prices, contract values, invoice amounts) unless they're already posted in this channel. Seat counts, renewal dates and ticket numbers are fine to include.

Someone with operator access needs to fix the Gateway's scheduler authorization before I can create the job. Once that's done, tell me and I'll set it up and run one test digest so you can check the format.
